description: Open source Discord moderation and music bot with slash commands.
features: Ban, kick, unban & timeout members with hierarchy checks
Bulk delete messages, slowmode, lock & unlock channels
Rank & XP system with level-up announcements
Role rewards for reaching specific levels
Auto reply system with multiple responses per trigger
YouTube notifications via RSS — no API key required
Music player with queue, skip, loop and saved playlists (YouTube & SoundCloud)
Ticket system with bug reports, feedback and support requests
